expansion.schema_note: Expansion manifest uses the Phase-124 crop-manifest columns. photo_box_xywh_200dpi holds the catalogue box scaled to 200 dpi with the v1 driver's int() truncation (comparability/exclusion key); crop_box_xywh_in_photo is in the coordinates of the 140-dpi photo the crop was actually cut from. Benchmark manifests use 200-dpi photos throughout, as in Phase-124.
expansion.scope: every Phase-124 catalogue row with side A/a, a recorded photo box and a non-degenerate box (h <= 1.5 w), excluding the 34 benchmark photo boxes; crops cut from the 140-dpi page cache (page_cache/)
